direita.description: A single powerful descending claw swipe, then return to guard. Compress the serpent coils and pull the striking hand back and up. Rotate hip and shoulder, bow the entire torso deeply forward and DOWN, and OPEN the clawed hand to slash down/forward across a low opponent. Keep natural arm length and solid hand volume by bringing the shoulder toward the target. Follow through low, then recoil and settle the weight into the coiled tail. Hair and cloth lag and settle. Stay facing right. Tail-ground anchor remains fixed at(80,136); no sliding, hopping, camera movement or change of scale. No human legs or feet, no weapon, no magic effects. Preserve the original adult model and crisp pixel style.
